verdict.rationale: Kling documents a cheaper 'std' generation mode alongside a pricier 'pro' mode, which covers fast, low-cost drafting. Nothing in the evidence shows an upscale or enhance step that lifts a chosen std take to final quality; native 4K generation is a separate render, not an upscale of an existing take. missing for 10: an upscale/enhance feature for a selected draft, a documented draft-to-final workflow that preserves the chosen take, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality
